material_news_signals.description: The Rams have activated pass rusher Myles Garrett (knee) from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Commanders, setting up the reigning Defensive Player of the Year to return to the lineup for the first time since Week 1.
material_news_signals.body_text: for once this season it is good news on the injury front for the rams los angeles has activated pass rusher myles garrett knee from injured reserve ahead of sunday s game against the commanders setting up the reigning defensive player of the year to return to the lineup for the first time since week 1 garrett carries no designation into the matchup and rams coach sean mcvay told reporters friday that he is expected to play versus washington barring any setbacks glad to be back on the field with my teammates garrett said friday making an impact feeling their presence and just integrating back with them again garrett who helped make the rams the story of the offseason thanks to his blockbuster trade from the browns to l a has been unable to make his usual impact on the regular season with the campaign already in november following the team s season opening loss to the 49ers during which garrett logged five pressures but failed to add a sack tackle or anything else to the stat sheet the five time all pro underwent knee surgery and was placed on ir he missed the past seven contests before being designated to return practicing in limited fashion twice and taking a rest day friday now he s officially back garrett rejoins a rams squad that has far underperformed expectations billed as a superteam after aaron donald unretired to join forces with garrett and other additions such as cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson on a defense that suddenly appeared every bit as good as an offense that led the league in points and yards in 2025 the rams are 4 4 sitting in third place in the nfc west at the midway point of the season they have dealt with myriad injuries beyond garrett star wide receiver puka nacua has missed two games and his counterpart davante adams is on ir as are other big names such as kobie turner and poona ford watson one of l a s aforementioned additions alongside garrett suffered a season ending shoulder injury last week and on saturday was placed on ir despite the disappointment thus far the rams still rank 10th in points scored and 12th in points allowed and they re top five in yards both offensively and defensively los angeles defense also ranks third in quarterback pressure percentage 41 0 though it has resulted in only 12 sacks which sits tied for 26th outside of the sacks those are all good respectable numbers but garrett was expected to help elevate the rams to an otherworldly level on the active roster again with a clean bill of health he can restart his pursuit of that aim which hardly got started in one injury affected outing before surgery i think the offenses really have to pick their poison garrett said ahead of playing his first nfl game with donald who was inactive for the season opener who is going to be freed up this play i think either of us are pretty good at winning one on ones so we ll have some fun garrett donald and the rams kick off against the commanders at 1 p m et on sunday

material_news_signals.headline: Jonathan Taylor landing spots: Ranking top 7 trade fits for Colts Pro Bowl running back
material_news_signals.description: With the NFL’s Nov. 10 trade deadline days away, all eyes are on Jonathan Taylor and the Colts. Kevin Patra identifies seven possible destinations for the star RB.
material_news_signals.body_text: with the nfl s nov 10 trade deadline days away all eyes are on jonathan taylor and the indianapolis colts with indy in clear rebuild mode after firing general manager chris ballard moving the veteran running back could return valuable draft capital while the jury is still out on whether the colts will get their trade price met for taylor several squads could use a pro bowl running back as we push toward thanksgiving let s take a quick gander at some potential landing spots for the former all pro running back the league s worst rushing attack could certainly use some help green bay is averaging a measly 60 6 yards per game and has four total rushing touchdowns worse they re not even getting the yards blocked per next gen stats the packers have a comical 164 rush yards over expected they re averaging 1 0 rush yards over expected per carry woof the pack hoped that josh jacobs return would jumpstart the unit while he s been better than marshawn watch me bounce everything outside lloyd jacobs too has been woefully inefficient jacobs has just 75 rushing yards in two games averaging 2 3 yards per carry and has 1 1 rush yards over expected per carry as a team the packers have 27 total missed tackles forced a trade for taylor would immediately help and green bay could potentially move on from jacobs in 2027 if not sooner the question is whether brian gutekunst who played it conservatively with his backfield entering the season would shell out the draft picks needed to make the deal i m not holding my breath even though the fit makes sense the minnesota passing offense has been horrific with kyler murray at the helm carson wentz may coax more consistency this week but a long term upgrade at running back could help solve another issue for the vikings aaron jones and jordan mason have dealt with injuries and while they have generated yardage it s been inefficient jones is averaging 0 5 rush yards over expected this season and mason sits at 0 3 the vikings run attack lacks explosive plays jones and mason have combined for 14 runs of 10 plus yards taylor has 18 alone this season minnesota s poor interior blocking has played a role but the inability of the vikings backs to break tackles has led to a stymied attack 24 combined missed tackles forced from jones and mason taylor has 35 upgrading the rushing attack would help make the passing attack easier by keeping the vikings in better down and distance situations john harbaugh hasn t been shy about checking in on upgrades up and down the roster for the nfc east leaders while the giants have other needs adding a player of taylor s caliber would certainly boost j j mccarthy and the offense injuries have siphoned off the depth of the backfield tyrone tracy is on injured reserve and starter cam skattebo is dealing with a hamstring injury devin singletary stands as the primary back if skattebo can t go this week taylor and skatt would make a nice one two punch that big blue could lean on down the stretch a splash move at the deadline could go a long way to ensuring the giants keep their division lead into january and provide them a chance to pull off a postseason upset there has been scuttlebutt for weeks about the broncos potentially trading for taylor the denver rushing attack can t find a groove ranking in the bottom seven in yards per game 92 6 and sitting 26th with a 36 2 run success rate broncos rbs have combined for 10 runs of 10 plus yards this season rj harvey landing on injured reserve wiped out one option j k dobbins has been inefficient averaging 3 3 yards per carry with 100 rush yards over expected jonah coleman has shown some upside the past two weeks since returning from injury including posting 104 scrimmage yards in week 8 is it enough to quiet the concerns cincy is possibly the most interesting landing spot for taylor chase brown is a solid dual threat back and the bengals are a pass funnel offense behind joe burrow however adding an upper echelon runner could provide a completely different dimension to the offense it d be a play for the playoffs when a ground attack could be even more beneficial particularly in bad weather games cincinnati has attempted 21 9 rushes per game second fewest in the nfl behind only green bay on 94 carries brown has generated 340 yards and one td with a 35 1 success rate taylor could provide a completely different tackle breaking element pair taylor s ability to slam through light boxes with burrow s dive bombing ability and the bengals chances of returning to the super bowl would skyrocket injuries and ineffectiveness have forced washington to cycle through backs this year jacory croskey merritt still leads the commanders in rushing despite landing on injured reserve after only five games rachaad white has offered no consistency austin ekeler is 31 coming off a season ending injury and jeremy mcnichols is out for the season it s not pretty even at 2 4 1 washington isn t out of the nfc east hunt this week could be significant for that race taylor s multi year contract also puts the commanders in play for me he d provide jayden daniels a reliable running mate beyond 2026 and solve a significant problem in d c news of treveyon henderson s unexpected medical emergency gives the pats more incentive to upgrade the backfield rhamondre stevenson has averaged 3 8 yards per carry corey kiner who has impressed in limited opportunities and generated 29 rush yards over expected on just 42 carries could see a significant increase in reps however with henderson sidelined we shouldn t rule out the pats who have surged back into contention from making a splash

material_news_signals.headline: Broncos make NFL history with 16th straight one-score win: 'It's not by accident'
material_news_signals.body_text: charlotte n c bo nix watched the football roll toward the wrong end zone one oblong end over the other and felt his stomach drop 34 i was not thinking good things 34 the broncos quarterback said after his pitch to running back jonah coleman in the fourth quarter sunday glanced off the rookie and scooted into open space carrying the fate of the game with each bounce 34 what if they got it and all of a sudden that 39 s the change in the game 34 nix should know by now that all is well for the broncos as long as the scoreboard at a game 39 s final whistle separates them from their opponent by a touchdown or less coleman dove on the ball to save possession pass rusher nik bonitto came through with a clutch strip sack of panthers quarterback bryce young a few moments later nix walked onto the field and closed the game in victory formation to preserve a 26 21 win that made nfl history all in another wild sunday 39 s work the triumph was the broncos 39 16th in a row in games decided by one score a new league record it was the sixth such victory just this season which is only nine weeks old do the broncos know any other way 34 when those things keep falling your way 34 broncos coach sean payton said 34 that 39 s not by accident 34 it would be disingenuous to discount an element of luck sprinkled across this streak of close shave wins for the broncos who moved to 7 2 as they enter their bye week it was present sunday when the loose ball bounced along in such a way that coleman could sprint and dive on it preventing a turnover that would have put the panthers on the doorstep of a winning score it was certainly present as a bryce young pass in the end zone on first down bounced off tight end tommy tremble 39 s hands and then his leg before broncos safety devon key snatched it just before it hit the ground and it was certainly present when payton pulled the challenge flag from his back right pocket the one with two ounces of sand at the end wrapped by three rubber bands and launched it onto the field just before the panthers could run the subsequent play late in the third quarter the referees initially ruled key 39 s interception as an incomplete pass not realizing the ball had hit tremble 39 s leg instead of the ground replay review not only determined key had caught the ball but also confirmed that payton had thrown the flag just before the next play began 34 that was a hard one for any of us to see 34 payton said of the play 34 and my concern was 39 was anybody able to see that i threw it before the play was snapped 39 fortunately the replay center in new york can 34 if an element of luck has played a role in this historic streak of close game triumphs though it is hardly the main ingredient four things were at hand in sunday 39 s win that have been the foundation of a season 39 s worth of these kinds of victories sharp play from nix in the moments that matter most a defense that always seems to produce a winning play even when its back has been shoved against a wall a head coach in payton whose preparation constantly puts denver on the front foot in tense moments and evan rothstein the director of game management a situational specialist who has been a major asset in denver 39 s life on the knife 39 s edge rothstein got a game ball from payton in the locker room after sunday 39 s game for his quick work in relaying the challenge opportunity to payton from a booth above bank of america stadium 34 that was the first i could recall like that ever where it was that close 34 payton said of the time between him throwing the flag and the ball being snapped rothstein addresses the team each week sharing different situational trends popping up around the league he is integral to denver 39 s detailed planning of the two minute situations that have been at the heart of so many of these one score victories but his impact goes well beyond the situational work 34 evan is an unbelievable offensive mind 34 right tackle mike mcglinchey said 34 he spent all season with us last year in the offensive line room and helped us tremendously with defensive introductions personnel groupings and how to see things differently he 39 s so valuable to our football team and has carved out an unbelievable role for himself just by sticking with it and grinding through years and years in this league he deserves all the credit because he 39 s as vital to what we 39 re doing as anybody 34 the key interception the first pick of the veteran 39 s career came as the broncos were on the verge of potentially falling into a 20 13 deficit gave the ball back to denver 39 s offense and the unit responded with back to back touchdown drives nix completed 8 of 11 passes for 90 yards and a touchdown pass in the fourth quarter he made three clutch third down throws across those two scoring drives including a 26 yard touchdown strike up the seam to pat bryant 34 i 39 ll be honest it seems like it 39 s always the same feeling 34 nix said about operating in tight fourth quarters 34 there 39 s always a look in the huddle that 39 s like 39 hey guys we don 39 t have a choice right here we got to go make something out of it 39 133 i thought that was the best part of the game because it showed that we stacked two drives together two critical moments and gave our defense some rest on the material_news_signals.description: The Baltimore Ravens are not expected to trade running back Derrick Henry before the Nov. 10 deadline, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Saturday.
material_news_signals.body_text: any team riding a four game losing streak into the trade deadline will generate some questions about potential roster moves that is doubly so for a would be contender like the ravens who are without quarterback lamar jackson for the foreseeable future due to a thumb injury but espn s adam schefter reported on saturday that baltimore is not expected to trade running back derrick henry schefter added that the team recently informed henry it did not intend to move him and henry echoed similar sentiments about his own desires following a 33 10 thursday night loss to the jaguars i have not mentioned me going anywhere else henry said when asked if he plans to still be with the team beyond the nov 10 deadline per team transcript i m saying let s go back to work let s try to get better and turn this thing around the ravens 4 5 are staring up at the rest of their rivals in a highly competitive afc north they re currently the only team in the division with a losing record with jackson on injured reserve and backup tyler huntley toe out for the season joe fagnano was overwhelmed and ineffective in a prime time drubbing at the hands of the jags suggesting there will be little resistance to the newly acquired jacoby brissett taking over the qb1 spot moving forward after his trade from the cardinals was finalized acquiring brissett in the first place suggests the ravens are still going for it which would require all hands on deck especially those of a five time pro bowler with 13 707 career rushing yards baltimore s problems at this point go beyond the void left by jackson s injury even though a signal caller of his caliber could have helped compensate for weaknesses elsewhere the ravens defense has given up 30 plus points in three straight and henry has been stymied over the past month after rushing for 476 yards and seven touchdowns with a 4 2 yards per carry average during his first five games henry has only managed 213 rushing yards a score and 3 4 yards per attempt over his last four without a game over 60 yards on the ground during that span it s why he s far more concerned with how to turn things around and move up in the standings than the outside noise of possibly moving anywhere else the ravens have a mini bye week now to get right then henry and co have four straight games against teams with losing records before a month s worth of afc north bouts to close out the campaign we have to henry said when asked if he believes baltimore can turn it around it s the only thing we can do is go back to work and try to get it going

material_news_signals.headline: NFL Network: Ravens' Lamar Jackson (right thumb) out 6-9 weeks, expects to return this season
material_news_signals.description: Lamar Jackson's latest injury has sidetracked the Ravens' 2026 season, but the two-time MVP may not be lost for the year.
material_news_signals.body_text: lamar jackson s latest injury has sidetracked the ravens 2026 season leaving them to trade for journeyman jacoby brissett this week amid a 4 5 start but the two time mvp may not be lost for the year the baltimore signal caller suffered a fractured and dislocated thumb on his right hand on nov 1 and is expected to miss at least six weeks after undergoing surgery nfl network s ian rapoport reported sunday jackson could miss up to nine weeks with his recovery which would put his return to play around the start of the postseason at the latest if the ravens make it that far rapoport reported that jackson told his teammates after week 8 that he plans to return later this season the ravens qb was initially reported to be out indefinitely with jackson and tyler huntley out for the season with turf toe placed on injured reserve the ravens were forced to start undrafted third stringer joe fagnano on thursday night against jacksonville it did not go well the ravens then acquired brissett on friday in a trade with hopes that the veteran qb can lead baltimore to enough wins in the ensuing weeks to make a jackson return worthwhile baltimore faces the chargers panthers texans and buccaneers a combined 8 21 record in the next five weeks before finishing the season with four games in the brutal afc north the ravens are currently last in the division jackson has started five games this season his first under coach jesse minter but has finished just three he left baltimore s week 4 game with an ankle sprain and missed three weeks upon his return in week 8 jackson was knocked out of the game on the ravens first offensive snap when his right hand collided with a bills defender on the season jackson is 68 of 97 passing for 967 yards six touchdowns and one interception adding 144 rushing yards and a td brissett started all eight of the cardinals games before being benched midway through their week 8 comeback win over dallas he was demoted to third string the following day and then dealt to baltimore the 33 year old journeyman has completed 63 3 of his passes for 1 719 yards 10 tds and seven ints this season brissett will try to keep baltimore afloat with the expectation that jackson can return to a playoff bound ravens team and take them over the top

material_news_signals.description: The Baltimore Ravens are not expected to trade running back Derrick Henry before the Nov. 10 deadline, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Saturday.

history that baltimore haslost by 20 plus points in three consecutive games obviously it s a tough situation for our guys but i just told them there s no excuses there s no whatever we don t have this guy we don t have that guy coach jesse minter said after the loss the defense was out there it felt like the whole half i thought they battled and fought and did a decent job in the second half but obviously the results are not acceptable for us and what we re after losing quarterbacks lamar jackson and tyler huntley to injury forced the ravens to start undrafted rookie joe fagnano on a short week the results were what you d expect the qb completed 10 of 18 passes for 60 yards threw two interceptions and took one sack the ravens rarely gave the rookie a chance to rip it and he didn t take it on the precious few early opportunities baltimore tried to lean on the ground game using derrick henry in the wildcat and copious amounts of misdirection you can dress up a ham sandwich with any number of accoutrements as you d like it s still a ham sandwich baltimore was held to 227 total yards and 10 first downs going 4 of 14 on third down and turning it over three times henry was slowed to 57 yards on 17 carries the soaked locals expressed their displeasure with loud halloween themed interjections before heading home early they have every right to boo or do whatever they want to do tight end mark andrews said obviously we re not used to this type of outcome it s not acceptable the lame duck offense will get the headlines but minter s defense has been among the most disappointing units in the entire nfl despite sporting pro bowl players at every level baltimore s d has been ripped up allowing 30 plus points in three straight games guys are frustrated defensive lineman calais campbell said but you got to take some pride in your work and you got to figure out a way at this point in time it s draw a line in the sand and decide where we go from here the offense not staying on the field surely has something to do with a defense that has morphed into a sieve the counter however is the opening drive a seven play touchdown march by the jags on thursday night on which the defense offered little resistance minter s defense has been average to below in nearly every statistical category this season thursday night when it was clear the offense would struggle with a backup qb in poor conditions the defense needed to carry the day previous iterations in baltimore would have instead the ravens broke it wasn t good enough we ve got to be better a clearly frustrated henry said it was the same story it wasn t good enough we ve got to be better with four straight losses sending them to 4 5 before a week 10 date with the current winless los angeles chargers they need to get a whole lot better fast to have any chance at saving the season

best way to learn how to win is to win and to finish this game is crazy the game of pro football is crazy 133 the men in that locker room weren 39 t gonna let us lose 34 the colts entered as one of the nfl 39 s worst teams they are one of eight teams that haven 39 t won more than two games their loss to the cowboys was their fifth consecutive as they have recently traded away franchise cornerstones quenton nelson and deforest buckner but they put up quite the fight like the arizona cardinals 3 6 did a week ago last week the cardinals erased a two touchdown fourth quarter deficit to eventually defeat the cowboys in overtime 33 30 on sunday the colts erased a 10 point deficit late in the third quarter to then take a 23 20 lead with 1 37 remaining this time dak prescott and company responded a four play 65 yard touchdown drive gave dallas the lead back for good the biggest play of the series and the entire game was prescott 39 s deep ball to ryan flournoy for a 46 yard gain on first down dallas 39 no 3 wide receiver behind ceedee lamb and george pickens hauled in the pass with one hand as colts cornerback sauce gardner was draped over him defensively dallas received strong performances from two of the group 39 s key players veteran defensive tackle quinnen williams and rookie defensive back caleb downs williams led the team with seven tackles three tackles for loss and a quarterback hit downs recorded his second sack of the season and his first career interception sealing the game in the final minute 34 we 39 ve got to play like it 39 s on us every play 34 downs said 34 we 39 ve got to play like our defense is the last stand that there 39 s no offense there 39 s just us playing separate games and that 39 s what we have to do people can say whatever they want but when we play well we 39 re a good football team 34 the cowboys entered the game with some surprising inactives led by pickens who has been dealing with a hamstring injury defensive starters joey porter foot and demarvion overshown back and hamstring were also inactive all three were questionable entering the game without pickens lamb was still able to keep up his impressive production hauling in 10 of his 16 targets for 195 yards and a touchdown the running game also got back on track after managing only 2 4 yards per carry against the cardinals javonte williams and tyler goodson combined for 178 yards on 5 6 yards per carry the biggest area that needs to be cleaned up is the penalties dallas finished with 14 for 153 yards the most notable being a 15 yard unsportsmanlike conduct penalty after overshown who was not in uniform ran onto the field to celebrate a fourth quarter shemar james fumble recovery 34 we 39 re going to take a look at all of them 34 schottenheimer said 34 i want to see what they all look like this is a crew that hadn 39 t called a lot of penalties there were a lot of penalties called so i want to look at the film before i speak on it 34 the win over the colts improves the cowboys to 4 5 second place in the nfc east behind the new york giants 5 2 1 but the toughest test so far and arguably the toughest of the year awaits next sunday when dallas hosts the 7 1 san francisco 49ers the cowboys stand almost no chance if they play like they have the last four weeks the 49ers will be the true test to show how this dallas team stacks up with the best in the league the early betting lines have san francisco around a 4 5 point favorite 34 the 49ers are a good football team 34 schottenheimer said 34 every team in this league is good that 39 s why there 39 s so much parity that 39 s why it 39 s such a popular sport but we 39 re going to enjoy this game see what we can figure out to clean up i thought again the defense did a good job with the takeaways we had the two turnovers there we have to win the turnover battle but we 39 ll enjoy this one and get ready for san fran starting monday 34 how ready does prescott think the cowboys are for a matchup with san francisco 34 we 39 ll see 34 he said 34 we got to be ready we 39 ve had these games up and down and we understand that it 39 s a good opponent coming in an nfc opponent and we 39 ll get them at home so we 39 ve got to make sure we have a great week of preparation to put ourselves in the best position to go out there and get a win and at the end of the day whatever it takes if it comes down to the end like this one whatever it takes regardless everybody every man in that locker room coaching staff support staff needs to have on their mind that we 39 ve got to get a win 34 between now and then there is one key date tuesday marks the nfl 39 s trade deadline the cowboys have said since the start of training camp that they 39 re open for business they proved that by trading second and sixth round picks to the pittsburgh steelers for porter on sept 30 it 39 s unlikely that dallas would be interested in trading away players to gain draft picks 34 we 39 re pushing to make our team better to make a run 34 cowboys executive vice president stephen jones said friday on 105 3 the fan 34 if we saw the right thing that could help us our goal would be to make this team better and make a run here as the season goes we got a lot of football left 34 pass rusher is the top need in dallas the offense isn 39 t expected to see any notable changes prescott thinks the have enough if you can make sure you have enough and get better go do it i encourage that but yeah they 39 ve done a hell of a job with the team they put together it 39 s on us now period 34 the cowboys haven 39 t been able to build on their previous success they haven 39 t had consecutive wins in almost a year their toughest task awaits sunday it 39 s the opportunity to see what they 39 ll material_news_signals.headline: Bengals' Joe Burrow enjoying Madrid's museums, feeling like ‘normal person’ ahead of Madrid game
material_news_signals.description: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is trying to make the most out of his first overseas game in the NFL.
material_news_signals.body_text: madrid cincinnati bengals quarterback joe burrow is trying to make the most out of his first overseas game in the nfl burrow and the bengals are in madrid to take on the atlanta falcons on sunday looking to win their fourth straight game and move to 6 2 in the afc north the trip is not only about football for burrow though he was not yet with the bengals when the team played its first two games abroad in 2016 and 2019 in london this is somewhere that i ve always wanted to go he said friday and so to be able to do it while doing what i love playing football is really a dream come true for me burrow said he was recognized by a group of americans studying abroad while walking around the spanish capital but was enjoying a bit of anonymity on the streets of madrid i usually expect to go pretty incognito and not have anybody recognize me he said it s a little bit more than that but i love being out here because i can feel like a normal person for a little while art connoisseur europe was also allowing burrow to enjoy one of his passions art i went to museo del prado on wednesday that was cool burrow said of spain s renowned art museum and the plan for his half day off on friday was to go find more art in madrid i d like to go see some more museums and go to an art gallery do a little shopping but we ll see he said fashion change shopping in madrid could also be an attractive option for burrow who s been known for his interest in fashion and bold pregame outfits and it could be good timing for him as the bengals quarterback said he has been going through a style change i ve tried to elevate my looks a little bit recently he said for a couple of years there i was full streetwear and i started out going suits on gameday every day and didn t really feel like that was me so i switched it up to full streetwear and that might have been an overcorrection in my creative mind i m finding a happy medium now spanish sports knowledge burrow said he grew up watching soccer and lamented not being able to see one of the two spanish powerhouses play while he was in spain i ve followed international sports for a long time followed real madrid for a long time watched barcelona play real madrid a lot he said played with both of those teams on fifa a lot when i was a kid and loved watching soccer my whole life really so i wish they played while we were here at their home stadium so we could go unfortunately that s not gonna happen but hopefully one day i can make it putting on a show burrow said the bengals explosive and dynamic offense will be fun to watch at real madrid s santiago bernabeu stadium he said he was excited about being the nfl s main attraction sunday morning in the united states i love the only game on tv on sunday morning when people back home wake up and i love showcasing our talents abroad and trying to bring attention to what we do he said offensive line praise burrow threw for five touchdowns and ran for another in overtime as the bengals rallied to defeat the tennessee titans 43 36 last sunday we re completing a lot of passes right now our offensive line is protecting great i think this is the best that that group has played since i ve been here which is really exciting to see he said and you know a lot of our young players are getting better and better and we have the right guys who attack every day with the intent to be better than the day before and i think that is so valuable in this sport super bowl contenders burrow said the bengals still have more to prove before deserving to be considered super bowl contenders i don t think we deserve it yet he said we haven t done enough there s still a lot of season left we certainly have to be a lot better than we have been if we want to be that team at the end of the year winning the super bowl we certainly can we have the capability to do it but right now we aren t there no fast food for zac taylor bengals coach zac taylor joked that he wouldn t really accept anyone going for american fast food while in madrid i ve judged a couple people he said now my kids might be opting for that if you re under 14 years old yes if not i will judge you greatly wide receiver ja 39 marr chase was quick to say friday that he wasn t one of those going for fast food but he did say he missed his chef he also said he was recognized maybe twice on the streets of madrid on thursday defensive tackle dexter lawrence said he missed his bed copyright 2026 by the associated press

material_news_signals.headline: Eagles QB Joe Milton prepares for first start: NFL is about 'being ready when your name is called'
material_news_signals.description: Joe Milton has never made an official start. Sunday, the former sixth-round pick will get his shot when the Philadelphia Eagles host the New York Giants.
material_news_signals.body_text: joe milton has never made an official start sunday the former sixth round pick will get his shot when the philadelphia eagles host the new york giants milton said thursday that throughout his career as a backup he s been preparing for this chance i was just pretty much going through the plays going through the week like i was a starter or like i was playing and just being ready milton said via the philadelphia inquirer and that s what the nfl is about just being ready when your name is called and just preparing for those moments milton entered the league with the patriots and flashed athleticism during preseason action in week 18 2024 drake maye took the start but milton played the majority of the contest completing 22 of 29 passes for 241 yards and a touchdown and rushing for another score last year he spent the season with dallas appearing in five games milton s last appearance was week 18 2025 for the cowboys when he played the entire second half versus the giants with dak prescott resting 7 13 73 pass yards one int 43 rush yards milton spent the offseason in dallas and while he showed promise again in preseason action the cowboys chose sam howell as prescott s backup milton signed to the dallas practice squad where the eagles plucked him on oct 16 after jalen hurts was placed on injured reserve due to blood clots milton was asked thursday how much of the eagles playbook he knows shoot whatever s in this week he said laughing milton is taking over for tanner mckee who has started the past three weeks the eagles offense has been a slog for most of the season during its six game skid since week 3 philly has been outgained by 889 yards worst in the nfl the hope is that milton can at least provide some pop to the limp unit he has averaged 10 2 air yards attempt since 2024 per next gen stats second most min 50 attempts both of milton s two career pass tds came on deep passes 20 air yds mckee told reporters he understood why he was benched and has been trying to help milton prepare he hasn t been here the whole time with training camp and some of those plays and so just talking to him about different reads different footwork things that we ve had a little more time on task doing here mckee said and so it s been great just communicating with him things that i ve seen in the past things that we ve learned from jalen or that offensive coordinator sean mannion has communicated in the past or things that we can reiterate to kind of slow his thinking down so he can just be free and be able to play like the great athlete he is the eagles hope that great athlete can wake up an offense that has struggled all season philly has gone three and out on 34 1 percent of drives the highest rate in the nfl and the highest in a season since the 2014 raiders 35 9 pct finished 3 13 the giants defense has forced a three and out on 32 9 percent of drives best in the nfl the eagles and giants kick off from lincoln things right with the game on the line in the final seconds it was this one down by a touchdown with the ball at the los angeles rams 39 31 yard line washington had time for at least one play maybe sailed far over the head of receiver stefon diggs and not on the second when daniels dumped the ball off on a crosser to tight end chig okonkwo who broke a couple of tackles before the play sputtered okonkwo ran up against the sideline to about the rams 39 11 and tried to pitch the ball backward to keep the play alive but instead tossed it onto the ground at which point the play fizzled along with allowed a sack of their quarterback on a critical third and 5 just before the two minute warning rams star myles garrett in his first game back after missing seven games with a knee injury blew past rookie center matt gulbin starter lucas patrick suffered a concussion earlier in the game to get to daniels the commanders lost 12 yards on that play one of garrett 39 s three sacks and yet the separates them from their opponent by a touchdown or less coleman dove on the ball to save possession pass rusher nik bonitto came through with a clutch strip sack of panthers quarterback bryce young 16th in a row in games decided by one score a new league record it was the sixth such victory just this season which is only nine weeks old do the broncos know any other way 34 when those things keep falling your way 34 broncos coach sean payton said 34 that 39 s not by accident 34 it would be disingenuous to discount an element of luck sprinkled across this streak of close shave wins for the broncos who moved to 7 2 as they enter their bye week it was present sunday when the loose ball bounced along in such a way that coleman could sprint and dive on it preventing a turnover that would have put the panthers on the doorstep of a winning score it was certainly present as a bryce young pass in the end zone on first down bounced off tight end tommy tremble 39 s hands and then his leg before broncos safety devon key snatched it just before it hit the ground and it was certainly present when payton pulled the challenge flag from his back right pocket the one with two ounces of sand at the end wrapped by three rubber bands and launched it onto the field just before the panthers could run the subsequent play late in the third quarter the referees initially ruled key 39 s interception as an incomplete pass not realizing the ball had hit tremble 39 s leg instead of the ground replay review not only determined key had caught the ball but also confirmed that payton had thrown the flag just before the next play began 34 that was a hard one for any of us to see 34 payton said of the play 34 and my concern was 39 was anybody able to see that i threw it before the play was snapped 39 fortunately the replay center in new york can 34 if an element of luck has played a role in this historic streak of close game triumphs though it is hardly the main ingredient four things were at hand in sunday 39 s win that have been the foundation of a season 39 s worth of these kinds of victories sharp play from nix in the moments that matter most a defense that always seems to produce a winning play even when its back has been shoved against a wall a head coach in payton whose preparation constantly puts denver on the front foot in tense moments and evan rothstein the director of game management a situational specialist who has been a major asset in denver 39 s life on the knife 39 s edge rothstein got a game ball from payton in the locker room after sunday 39 s game for his quick work in relaying the challenge opportunity to payton from a booth above bank of america stadium 34 that was the first i could recall like that ever where it was that close 34 payton said of the time between him throwing the flag and the ball being snapped rothstein addresses the team each week sharing different situational trends popping up around the league he is integral to denver 39 s detailed planning of the two minute situations that have been at the heart of so many of these one score victories but his impact goes well beyond the situational work 34 evan is an unbelievable offensive mind 34 right tackle mike mcglinchey said 34 he spent all season with us last year in the offensive line room and helped us tremendously with defensive introductions personnel groupings and how to see things differently he 39 s so valuable to our football team and has carved out an unbelievable role for himself just by sticking with it and grinding through years and years in this league he deserves all the credit because he 39 s as vital to what we 39 re doing as anybody 34 the key interception the first pick of the veteran 39 s career came as the broncos were on the verge of potentially falling into a 20 13 deficit gave the ball back to denver 39 s offense and the unit responded with back to back touchdown drives nix completed 8 of 11 passes for 90 yards and a touchdown pass in the fourth quarter he made three clutch third down throws across those two scoring drives including a 26 yard touchdown strike up the seam to pat bryant 34 i 39 ll be honest it seems like it 39 s always the same feeling 34 nix said about operating in tight fourth quarters 34 there 39 s always a look in the huddle that 39 s like 39 hey guys we don 39 t have a choice right here we got to go make something out of it 39 133 i thought that was the best part of the game because it showed that we stacked two drives together two critical moments and gave our defense some rest on the sideline with those longer drives 34 the broncos were decimated with injuries in the secondary sunday already without starting safeties talanoa hufanga and brandon jones they lost starting corner riley moss to a concussion in the first half with kris abrams draine also out with an ankle injury the broncos were forced to shuffle jahdae barron to outside corner after he began the game as denver mcmillian a north carolina native playing in front of 34 30 or 40 34 family members and close friends made a sack that set up a fourth and 18 for the panthers somehow receiver john metchie found an drive carolina had the ball back with a chance to drive for the winning score it was a frightening prospect for the scores of broncos fans in attendance given that young had already thrown for 276 yards and three touchdowns that 39 s when bonitto the all pro pass rusher met the challenge that had been issued to him by teammate alex singleton 34 i talked to nik bonitto earlier in the game and said 39 we need one 39 34 singleton said referring to a takeaway 34 when a lot of different guys are playing your best players have to step up he was able to do that right there and that 39 s what you expect out of a player like that i was over the moon that he made that 34 one of the wins in this 16 game streak came last season at washington when bonitto leapt and swatted a pass by commanders quarterback marcus mariota preserving a walk off win for the broncos this time with the panthers facing a first and 10 at the denver 36 yard line with 1 24 left bonitto burst off the line and got a step on tackle rasheed walker bonitto looking like von miller in the super bowl against the panthers in 2015 kept powering into the backfield even as walker grabbed his helmet his vision obscured the broncos quarterback said after his pitch to running back jonah coleman in the fourth quarter sunday glanced off the rookie and scooted into open space carrying the fate of the game with each bounce 34 what if they got it and all of a sudden that 39 s the change in the game 34 nix should know by now that all is well for the broncos as long as the scoreboard at a game 39 s final whistle separates them from their opponent by a touchdown or less coleman dove on the ball to save possession pass rusher nik bonitto came through with a clutch strip sack of panthers quarterback bryce young a few moments later nix walked onto the field and closed the game in victory formation to preserve a 26 21 win that made nfl history all in another wild sunday 39 s work the triumph was the broncos 39 16th in a row in games decided by one score a new league record it was the sixth such victory just this season which is only nine weeks old do the broncos know any other way 34 when those things keep falling your way 34 broncos coach sean payton said 34 that 39 s not by accident 34 it would be disingenuous to discount an element of luck sprinkled across this streak of close shave wins for the broncos who moved to 7 2 as they enter their bye week it was present sunday when the loose ball bounced along in such a way that coleman could sprint and dive on it preventing a turnover that would have put the panthers on the doorstep of a winning score it was certainly present as a bryce young pass in the end zone on first down bounced off tight end tommy tremble 39 s hands and then his leg before broncos safety devon key snatched it just before it hit the ground and it was certainly present when payton pulled the challenge flag from his back right pocket the one with two ounces of sand at the end wrapped by three rubber bands and launched it onto the field just before the panthers could run the subsequent play late in the third quarter the referees initially ruled key 39 s interception as an incomplete pass not realizing the ball had hit tremble 39 s leg instead of the ground replay review not only determined key had caught the ball but also confirmed that payton had thrown the flag just before the next play began 34 that was a hard one for any of us to see 34 payton said of the play 34 and my concern was 39 was anybody able to see that i threw it before the play was snapped 39 fortunately the replay center in new york can 34 if an element of luck has played a role in this historic streak of close game triumphs though it is hardly the main ingredient four things were at hand in sunday 39 s win that have been the foundation of a season 39 s worth of these kinds of victories sharp play from nix in the moments that matter most a defense that always seems to produce a winning play even when its back has been shoved against a wall a head coach in payton whose preparation constantly puts denver on the front foot in tense moments and evan rothstein the director of game management a situational specialist who has been a major asset in denver 39 s life on the knife 39 s edge rothstein got a game ball from payton in the locker room after sunday 39 s game for his quick work in relaying the challenge opportunity to payton from a booth above bank of america stadium 34 that was the first i could recall like that ever where it was that close 34 payton said of the time between him throwing the flag and the ball being snapped rothstein addresses the team each week sharing different situational trends popping up around the league he is integral to denver 39 s detailed planning of the two minute situations that have been at the heart of so many of these one score victories but his impact goes well beyond the situational work 34 evan is an unbelievable offensive mind 34 right tackle mike mcglinchey said 34 he spent all season with us last year in the offensive line room and helped us tremendously with defensive introductions personnel groupings and how to see things differently he 39 s so valuable to our football team and has carved out an unbelievable role for himself just by sticking with it and grinding through years and years in this league he deserves all the credit because he 39 s as vital to what we 39 re doing as anybody 34 the key interception the first pick of the veteran 39 s career came as the broncos were on the verge of potentially falling into a 20 13 deficit gave the ball back to denver 39 s offense and the unit responded with back to back touchdown drives nix completed 8 of 11 passes for 90 yards and a touchdown pass in the fourth quarter he made three clutch third down throws across those two scoring drives including a 26 yard touchdown strike up the seam to pat bryant 34 i 39 ll be honest it seems like it 39 s always the same feeling 34 nix said about operating in tight fourth quarters 34 there 39 s always a look in the huddle that 39 s like 39 hey guys we don 39 t have a choice right here we got to go make something out of it 39 133 i thought that was the best part of the game because it showed that we stacked two drives together two critical moments and gave our defense some rest on the sideline with those longer drives 34 the broncos were decimated with injuries in the secondary sunday already without starting safeties talanoa hufanga and brandon jones they lost starting corner riley moss to a concussion in the first half with kris abrams draine also out with an ankle injury the broncos were forced to shuffle jahdae barron to outside corner after he began the game as denver 39 s nickel safety jl skinner who came up with a key stop of kenneth walker during last week 39 s goal line stand to beat the chiefs was pressed into action as denver 39 s deep safety and struggled to stay with veteran tight end darren waller who torched the broncos as he had during so many games while playing with the afc west rival raiders denver seemingly had the game in hand after ja 39 quan mcmillian a north carolina native playing in front of 34 30 or 40 34 family members and close friends made a sack that set up a fourth and 18 for the panthers somehow receiver john metchie found an open space in denver 39 s deep coverage and caught a 25 yard pass from young setting up a touchdown to pull the panthers to within five points after the coleman fumble spoiled denver 39 s ensuing drive carolina had the ball back with a chance to drive for the winning score it was a frightening prospect for the scores of broncos fans in attendance given that young had already thrown for 276 yards and three touchdowns that 39 s when bonitto the all pro pass rusher met the challenge that had been issued to him by teammate alex singleton 34 i talked to nik bonitto earlier in the game and said 39 we need one 39 34 singleton said referring to a takeaway 34 when a lot of different guys are playing your best players have to step up he was able to do that right there and that 39 s what you expect out of a player like that i was over the moon that he made that 34 one of the wins in this 16 game streak came last season at washington when bonitto leapt and swatted a pass by commanders quarterback marcus mariota preserving a walk off win for the broncos this time with the panthers facing a first and 10 at the denver 36 yard line with 1 24 left bonitto burst off the line and got a step on tackle rasheed walker bonitto looking like von miller in the super bowl against the panthers in 2015 kept powering into the backfield even as walker grabbed his helmet his vision obscured bonitto reached out his right arm and slammed it onto young 39 s arm just before he could release the ball 34 he held me but they ain 39 t gonna call it 34 in that situation bonitto said 34 it 39 s just relentless rushing at the end of the day trying to make a play for the team 34 the play was indicative of how these broncos have operated under payton in the close game situations like the ones that unfolded sunday his mantra is 34 ignore the scoreboard 34 it 39 s a message that is driven home weekly a reminder that the only thing that matters is making the next play 34 we just keep playing that way 34 singleton said 34 we don 39 t necessarily want to be in those situations but it 39 s much better than not winning 16 of them 34 payton had a simple message sunday 34 i like our team 34 yes the trade deadline is tuesday the broncos have already had conversations about their roster and will do so over the next two days but payton likes the direction of a team that has won five straight games overall there is still plenty to improve upon he said though the offense has made strides in recent weeks there have still been too many empty possessions consistency in the run game remains elusive injuries are stretching the defense making the upcoming bye week a welcome reprieve shoring up those areas could help the broncos avoid weekly participation in one score affairs the rest of the way in the chase for a second straight afc west title or maybe this is just how it goes for this team 34 at the end of the day in 10 15 years nobody 39 s going to care about it 34 nix said 34 they 39 re going to talk about wins instead of the streak but it 39 s cool right now it 39 s great as we go but it definitely would be nice to win by more than a score 34 this article originally appeared
